land.text: Corsica, whose 'secession from France was declared' at the consulta of Corte in 1793

predecessors.note: Cliopatria has no Corsican row for 1793-1796; the Corsican Republic row ends in 1768.

successors.note: Retaken by France after the British evacuation of 11 October 1796.

capitals.name: Bastia
capitals.note: 'Sir Gilbert moved the capital in early 1795.'

correction.text: Corsica: the Anglo-Corsican Kingdom, a 'client state of the Kingdom of Great Britain'

keyframe_review.note: New keyframe: Cliopatria has no Anglo-Corsican row; it draws Corsica as direct land of the Kingdom of Great Britain in 1794-1796 (34 cells, about 8,700 km2). The page gives no area. The page calls it 'a client state of the Kingdom of Great Britain' with 'Status: Personal union with Great Britain', so it is a colony-type tint of the British metropole and not direct British land (the kingdom-of-great-britain dossier takes the cells out).

ledger.note: June 1794: the Anglo-Corsican Kingdom is set up. Infobox 'Established: 15-19 June 1794'; 'Viceroy: Sir Gilbert Elliot, 4th Baronet'; 'Status: Personal union with Great Britain'; capital Corte.

June 1794: the kingdom is a client of the British crown from its establishment. Infobox 'Status: Personal union with Great Britain', 'Established: 15-19 June 1794'. Mirror of the kingdom-of-great-britain vassal_start (added by reviewer eu-11-l).
1795: the capital moves from Corte to Bastia. 'Sir Gilbert moved the capital in early 1795.'
11 October 1796: the British evacuate. Infobox 'British evacuation: 11 October 1796'. Mirror of the kingdom-of-great-britain vassal_end (added by reviewer eu-11-l).

11 October 1796: the British evacuate and the kingdom ends. Infobox 'British evacuation: 11 October 1796', 'Conquered: 19 October 1796'; 'With Spain coming in on the side of the French' the British 'realised their position in the Mediterranean was precarious'.

wars.name: Siege of Calvi
wars.outcome: The infobox gives the siege as 17 June - 10 August 1794, in the weeks the kingdom was established; the lines read do not state the result in words.
wars.note: Dates only from the infobox ('Siege of Calvi: 17 June - 10 August 1794').

certainty.note: An island: the coast is the border. Which towns the British and the French held inside it is not on the page.

sources.title: Anglo-Corsican Kingdom - Wikipedia
sources.note: Anglo-Corsican Kingdom: established 15-19 June 1794, personal union, client state, viceroy Elliot, capital Corte then Bastia, evacuation 11 October 1796, conquered 19 October 1796; no area.

notes: Written from one page (Anglo-Corsican Kingdom), a state Cliopatria lacks that the kingdom-of-great-britain dossier needs as a counterpart. Typed colony: a personal-union client of the British crown. The page does not say who held Corsica before June 1794 beyond the 1793 consulta at Corte ('Corsica's secession from France was declared'), so the predecessor french-first-republic is the researcher's reading. Elba and the British stay there are in the Elba page, not here. Viceroy Elliot's dates are not on the page, so no rulers list. REVIEW eu-11-l (2026-10-25): vassal_start/vassal_end with kingdom-of-great-britain added to mirror that dossier's events.
